results.name: Controller picker is visible, has twelve families, and defaults to Pico 2 carrier
Every new variant creates a locked, routable, correctly sized header template
No-hole hosts cannot accidentally enable invented mounting drills
FeatherWing-style add-on exposes the bottom mating face and variant-specific FREE contact
Place-on-current-board preserves the boundary and adds the selected exact interface
Inspector shows functional contact labels, source model and editable RF/access regions
Guard dimensions and stack-gap edits are one undoable operation
RF override requires a recorded reason; the accepted override remains a warning
Hiding overlays does not disable guards or alter manufacturing output
Rotate and flip controls transform the attached guard without changing its two-face protection
Actual worker refills both plane faces around the attached RF exclusion
Visible Via tool refuses to place a via inside the RF guard
Saved JSON and project ZIP retain schema 4, host metadata, guards and planes
KiCad export discloses metadata loss and includes two independent keepout zones
Bench and clearance inspector render the controller and its separate reference geometry
Controller selection and template workflow fit a 390 px viewport
No uncaught browser errors or external runtime dependencies
